subject: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan — Orchid Tech trial
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orchidtech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 13:12:00 -0500
Subject: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan — Orchid Tech trial

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and a proposed POC plan so we have alignment on success criteria, timeline, and owners. I attached a short outline (orchid-poc-outline.pdf) — see summary below.

Key takeaways from the call:
- Primary goal: validate that Redwood can reduce per-request latency to <150ms p50 for Orchid's internal search assistant (averaging 600 token responses) and lower inference cost by at least 30% vs current baseline.
- Secondary goal: confirm data controls (VPC + KMS) and logs for auditability for a potential enterprise deployment.
- Stakeholders: Samantha (Product), Raj Patel (Head of Data) — please confirm if Raj should be on the kickoff invite.

Proposed POC success criteria (suggested; please edit):
1) Latency: p50 <150ms, p95 <500ms on peak concurrency of 20 req/s
2) Cost: token inference cost <= 0.70x baseline on representative workload
3) Quality: model responses meet existing prompts' BLEU-like pass rate on our shared eval prompts (>=90% pass on the 50-sample set)
4) Security: ability to pin routing to a Private deployment + KMS integration for keys and audit log availability

Evaluation plan (2-week technical trial):
- Week 0 (now): finalize MAP and dataset delivery commitments
- Week 1 (setup): private trial environment + data ingestion; baseline run using your sample dataset
- Week 2 (eval): run benchmark across latency/cost/quality; joint review and remediation items

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood: Connor (program lead), Marissa (SE — infra & benchmark), Dylan (integration & support)
- Orchid: Samantha (product lead), Raj (data lead), Maya (security)

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Confirm success criteria above (reply with edits)
2) Confirm dataset access (S3 link or sample export) and expected delivery date
3) Confirm desired kickoff week — we can start as early as Feb 22 if dataset arrives by Feb 24; otherwise we can shift to the week of Mar 1.
4) Let us know any required paperwork (NDA/MAP/procurement) to attach to the HubSpot record.

Attachments: orchid-poc-outline.pdf (PDF, 83 KB)

Thanks — I'll hold the proposed kickoff slots on my calendar until we lock dates.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orchidtech.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan — Orchid Tech trial

Thanks, Connor — great summary and really helpful. A few quick notes from our side:

- Success criteria: the latency numbers look right; for quality we prefer a pass/fail rubric on 50 critical prompts (we'll share the rubric). Cost target looks good but we may need a short workshop with finance to map to our internal cost metrics.
- Stakeholders: Raj will be the primary data contact; I'll loop in Maya Chen (security) for the SOC2/KMS questions.
- Timeline: moving kickoff to week of Mar 1 would be easier for us because Raj is traveling next week. Can you confirm availability the week of Mar 1?
- Paperwork: we'll need a short trial license (60 days) and an executed mutual action plan (MAP). Also, can you provide a SOC2 summary + list of encryption controls for our security team?

Internal contacts for setup:
- Raj Patel <raj.patel@orchidtech.com> (Head of Data)
- Maya Chen <maya.chen@orchidtech.com> (Security)

If you can send updated outline with the 60-day trial terms and a quick SOC2 checklist, I can get procurement and security aligned.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Lee
Director of Product, Orchid Tech
samantha.lee@orchidtech.com | +1 617-555-0123
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orchidtech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo recap + Proposed POC plan — Orchid Tech trial

Hi Samantha —

Appreciate the quick reply and the clarity on stakeholders. We've updated the POC outline to reflect a 60-day trial and pushed a v2 (orchid-poc-outline-v2.pdf) that includes: the 60-day trial terms, trial license scope, a short SOC2 controls checklist, and a draft MAP. I'm also sharing a Google folder with the benchmark scripts and the HubSpot record below.

Proposed updated timeline (per your note):
- Week of Mar 1: kickoff + environment access (we'll plan for a 60-day trial start on Mar 1)
- Mar 1–Mar 15: setup and initial baseline runs
- Mar 16–Mar 31: joint evaluation period and final review

Ownership recap:
- Redwood: Connor (program lead) — overall coordination & MAP; Marissa — benchmark setup & infra; Dylan — integration and on-call for the first 2 weeks
- Orchid: Samantha — product owner; Raj — dataset and validation; Maya — security approvals

Action items for Orchid before kickoff:
1) Confirm dataset delivery method and share S3 or GDrive link (we need sample dataset by Feb 24 to keep the Mar 1 start; if not possible, confirm a Mar 8 start)
2) Provide contact email for procurement to route MAP/trial license (we will generate a DocuSign link)
3) Confirm Raj and Maya availability for the kickoff (30–45 minute technical + security sync)

Attachments: orchid-poc-outline-v2.pdf (PDF, 110 KB)
Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-orchid-poc, HubSpot record HUBSPOT-ORCH-534
SOC2 summary: https://redwood.ai/security/soc2-summary
DocuSign (MAP draft): https://app.docusign.com/sandbox/REDWOOD-MAP-ORCH-534

I'll coordinate internally to prepare a 60-day trial license and get the MAP ready for your procurement contact. Tentatively holding Mar 1 kickoff at 09:00 AM ET — I'll only lock it once we have dataset confirmation.

Best,
Connor
